title: Chapter 616 - 616 Beast-Swapping Physique; Forbidden Area!
content:
Chapter 616 - 616 Beast-Swapping Physique; Forbidden Area!

Chapter 616 - 616 Beast-Swapping Physique; Forbidden Area!

616 Beast-Swapping Physique; Forbidden Area!

Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, Sam, Abraham, and the heroes of the various countries disappeared from the level-nine forbidden area.

In the next moment, they appeared where they were before the countdown began.

Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam were still together.

Abraham appeared alone in a forest.

…

In Hua Natin’s live broadcast room.

“Oh my god!” the host shouted. “Can someone tell me what happened in the level-nine forbidden area? Why did such a large desert suddenly become an oasis?”

Potter: [I… I don’t know either.]

Hasda: [This is unbelievable!]

Marlous: [It’s Lin Fan. It’s Hua Nation’s Lin Fan! He killed the most powerful Sand Python King in the level-nine forbidden area. In order to prevent the Sand Python King from reviving, he turned the entire desert into an oasis!]

Milo: [That’s right! It’s Lin Fan. He’s amazing!]

Alan: [The desert turned into an oasis… Is he really a god?]

Lyson: [Perhaps he has done something gods have never done.]

…

After many countries found out what had happened, they were all extremely shocked.

Some countries chose to start watching Hua Nation’s broadcast.

In an instant, the popularity of Hua Nation’s live streaming channels soared.

…

In the Otherworld.

Compared to the shock of the crowd, Lin Fan did not take what happened in the level-nine forbidden area to heart at all.

The sky gradually darkened.

The Heavenly Hound brought a big rabbit over.

Then, as usual, Lin Fan roasted the rabbit meat and slept. He was extremely satisfied.

Four days passed in a flash.

These four days, Lin Fan lived very peacefully. He did not encounter any beasts.

In these four days, he had gained 300 Constitution points and 800 points of spiritual energy.

When Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam walked into a bush…

In the distance, a dull sound suddenly sounded.

In the next moment, a figure with a tall nose appeared in front of them.

It was Abraham, whom they had met several times.

At this moment, a two-headed lion that was five meters tall was chasing Abraham, roaring from time to time.

Originally, Abraham’s face was filled with despair.

However, when he raised his head and looked into the distance, he suddenly saw Lin Fan and the others. He immediately became extremely excited.

He had seen Lin Fan’s strength and knew how strong he was.

As long as Lin Fan was around, Abraham felt that he was absolutely safe in the Otherworld!

Thus, after Abraham came out of the level-nine forbidden ground, he had been looking for Lin Fan.

It was also because of this that he unintentionally provoked this two-headed lion.

While Abraham was excited, he paused for a moment.

This pause…

The two-headed lion behind him suddenly caught up.

It raised its paw and slapped Abraham’s head.

Abraham could even feel the cold light coming from his claws, and all the hair on his body instantly stood on end.

A strong sense of death surged into Abraham’s heart like a tide.

However, the claws did not touch Abraham’s head for a long time.

Instead, the two heads of the lion and its claws fell to the ground.

Blood spurted out!

When Abraham slowly raised his head, he saw that Lin Fan had already pulled out the Star Meteorite Sword.

Lin Fan had saved him!

Soon, Abraham’s guess was confirmed.

An emotionless voice rang out at the scene.

[The first to kill a level-six Two-Headed Lion. You’ve obtained a level-six treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-six Two-Headed Lion. 60 kinds of lost animals and plants have been revived.]

Then, an ancient chest appeared in front of them.

Lin Fan stepped forward and waved his hand. The chest opened.

[You’ve received 500 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—5,000 Constitution points.]

His strength had increased!

Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, “Abraham, you use these 500 points of Constitution.”

After all, the reason why he was able to obtain 5,000 Constitution points was also because of Abraham.

Giving him these points was nothing.

Lin Fan did not wait for Abraham to speak. He waved his hand, and the ball of light entered Abraham’s body.

Abraham felt the growing power in his body and finally recovered from the death crisis.

He said sincerely, “Thank you, Lin Fan!”

“Not only did you save me again, but you also gave me 500 Constitution points. I’m really… I really don’t know what to do. I can only say thank you again!”

Lin Fan waved his hand. “You’re welcome.”

“Why do I feel like every time I see you, you’re fighting a ferocious beast? Do you have a Beast-Swapping Physique?”

Huh?

Abraham was the one being chased by ferocious beasts every time, no?

Abraham’s old face was a little red, and he said, “That… That’s just a coincidence.”

After a pause, he said, “Uh… Can I continue to follow you?”

Lin Fan did not mind. “Sure.”

Abraham became even happier when he heard this.

Safety, food, water… Everything was guaranteed!

As for becoming stronger?

No matter how strong he was, could he be stronger than Lin Fan?

How was that possible?

Furthermore, as long as Lin Fan gave away some trash that he did not want, he would probably be able to become stronger even faster than if he were to continue adventuring in the Otherworld alone.

It was just like the 500 Constitution points that Lin Fan had given him.

Everyone once again set foot on the road ahead.

A few days ago, Lin Fan and his group did not encounter any ferocious beasts at all.

However, this afternoon, they encountered three of them in a row.

After killing three beasts, Lin Fan obtained 7,000 Constitution points and 4,000 points of spiritual energy.

Hua Nation’s pollution had decreased by 20%, the number of endangered animals had increased by 10%.

The harvest in one day far exceeded the past few days.

Lin Fan looked at Abraham with a weird gaze and said, “You really don’t have the Beast-Swapping Physique?”

Abraham stammered, “I-It’s just a coincidence.”

“Oh.” Lin Fan nodded his head noncommittally.

Abraham felt that Lin Fan did not believe him.

“It’s really just a coincidence,” he hurriedly explained. “We definitely won’t encounter any ferocious beasts later.”

However…

At this moment, an emotionless voice sounded in everyone’s ears.

[Entering level-ten forbidden area.]

[Countdown, 10!]

[9!]

[8!]

…

When Lin Fan heard that, he looked at Abraham with a weird gaze.

He did not speak.

However, his expression seemed to be saying, ‘And you still say that you don’t have a Beast-Swapping Physique? Now, he even brought them to a level-ten forbidden area.’

Abraham had a feeling that he could not explain himself.

Then, there was another wave of worry.

The forbidden area… represented danger!

Terrifying unknown danger!
